requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy - organized storage with compartments
requirements.evidence: 4-cell build (piece:0,0,0;full + 3 neighbors) with 4 bins: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full and three div2 bins (0,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0) providing 7 separate compartments for sorting supplies

requirements.requirement: Props dressing to show sewing use
requirements.evidence: No sewing-specific props (thread, scissors, fabric) exist in catalog; dressed with workshop tools as proxies (tape measure, screwdriver, pliers, tweezers) to demonstrate caddy function. Functions as tidy organizer but not visually sewing-specific.

finish.summary: Built compact 4-cell organizer with one open bin and three 2-compartment divided bins (7 sections total), capped and bolted. Dressed with small tools to illustrate tidy storage; no sewing-specific props available so used closest analogues.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: A compact caddy for your sewing bits — I'll set one up for tidy sorting.
